world_seed.visual_direction: Oxidized teal membranes, ivory ceramic hardware, saffron signal threads

premise: Inside a colossal biomechanical lung orbiting a gas giant, breathable atmosphere is traded as futures and each exhalation tide changes which institutions can reach one another.
simulation_objective: Manage the flow of oxygen and political influence through the tidal shifts of the lung's respiration cycle.
economy_focus: Breath futures and pressure-based access rights
exploration_focus: Navigating shifting biological corridors and securing valve control
conflict_hooks: The South Lobe is experiencing a necrotic collapse, threatening the value of all current air futures.
A rogue faction has seized the Central Diaphragm, demanding a tax on every inhalation.
visual_style: Top-down pixel art, oxidized teal membranes, ivory ceramic hardware, saffron signal threads, charcoal shadows.

social_rules: Breath is life; wasting air is a capital offense.
